title: gen_sprites.py header output enumeration not extended with the 5.11 sprites
evidence:
tools/gen_sprites.py line 14 (module docstring, unchanged by this PR):
"Output: assets/sprites/{house_0..3, host, dc, puck_1..3}.png + sprites.json"
while assets/sprites/sprites.json order now ends:
  "puck_3",
  "small_biz",
  "campus"
 ]
detail: The module's reproducibility contract still enumerates only the 9 canon sprites; a future minion reading the header learns an incomplete output set. Same-file constants and main() were updated, the header enumeration was not.
recommended_fix: Update the docstring line to 'assets/sprites/{house_0..3, host, dc, puck_1..3, small_biz, campus}.png + sprites.json' (or 'the 11 roster sprites').
